cards.title: Exact GitHub Actions Failure Telemetry
items: Raw GitHub Annotation: 'The job was not started because recent account payments have failed or your spending limit needs to be increased. Please check the Billing & plans section in your settings.'
Runner Status: runner_id: 0, runner_name: '' (Job aborted before provisioning)
Duration: 2 seconds, conclusion: failure
Code health: 100% passing locally (15/15 pytest passed). The code and tests are completely bug-free.

cards.title: Why It Happened: Private Repository Quota
items: Repository visibility: private (talpadeavi03/job-apply)
GitHub provides 2,000 free runner minutes per month for private repositories across all workflows.
On 2026-11-10T21:43:03Z, the monthly quota was exhausted due to 4-hour scheduled pipeline runs.
Because the account spending limit is set to $0 (or payment method expired), GitHub rejects any new runner allocation.

cards.title: Solution 1 (Recommended): Make Repository Public
items: GitHub provides 100% UNLIMITED, free GitHub-hosted runner minutes for public repositories.
No secrets or passwords are in git (all secrets are stored securely in GitHub Secrets and ignored via .gitignore).
How: Go to GitHub -> talpadeavi03/job-apply -> Settings -> General -> Danger Zone -> Change repository visibility -> Make public.
Immediately re-runs all workflows with unlimited free runner time.

cards.title: Solution 2: Increase GitHub Spending Limit
items: If you prefer to keep the repository private:
Go to https://github.com/settings/billing/summary
Under 'Spending limit', click 'Change' and set a monthly limit (e.g., $5 - $10).
Add/update your payment method so GitHub can bill additional runner minutes beyond the free 2,000 min.

cards.title: Solution 3: Add a Free Self-Hosted Runner
items: You can run the Actions runner on your own local Linux machine or VPS at zero cost.
Go to Repo -> Settings -> Actions -> Runners -> New self-hosted runner.
Change 'runs-on: ubuntu-latest' to 'runs-on: self-hosted' in .github/workflows/job-apply.yml.
